create_NoBaseline: create a NoBaseline instance that returns a constant zero baseline for any loss tensor
create_MeanBaseline: create a MeanBaseline instance that maintains a running mean of observed losses over time
create_BuiltInBaseline: create a BuiltInBaseline instance that computes per-row baselines using the mean of all other rows
review_Baseline_abstract_class: review the Baseline abstract class and its update and predict interface methods
test_MeanBaseline_update_predict: test the MeanBaseline update and predict methods with a batch of loss tensors
